results.detail: Running config already matches the deployed settings; nothing changed

session.debrief: The scenario requested a bad runtime configuration reload on gateway-c. When that succeeds, the process stays live and its container keeps running, so liveness, container state, CPU and disk all look normal. On a gateway, the upstream address points at a port nothing listens on, so every business request fails to connect, which looks like a stopped catalogue until the catalogue is checked directly. On the catalogue, the data source points at a dataset that was never deployed, so its business requests fail with HTTP 500 and both gateways' fail with them. The running config shows the drifted setting next to its deployed value, and the log records the reload. Restoring the deployed config fixes it. Injection outcome: succeeded. The action record explains the exercise but was not evidence available during the investigation. Other evidence-supported investigation orders are valid.
